compositionCapacity.note: Necessary bounds are not a mathematical sufficiency proof. The actual UTC simulation verifies the measured repeat window; one to two distinct location groups replace the earlier maximum of one.

remainingCandidates.reason: Positive functional examples do not cover ordinary weapons and every qualifying prop. The broad template remains pending rather than rejecting obvious unreviewed answers.

Loadouts are separate from confirmed drops. Only individual item acquisition clauses and earlier explicit proofs establish drops. Generic Ranged Weapon entries do not define complete random loot pools.

remainingCandidates.candidate: NPC-specific services and items for sale
remainingCandidates.reason: The interaction taxonomy is reviewed (tips merged as one interaction). Explicit seasonal purchase clauses add verified NPC sale/service edges, but full vendor inventories, prices and change windows are not comprehensively joined. No complete vendor-item prompt is enabled.

remainingCandidates.candidate: Guard factions and henchman spawn locations
remainingCandidates.reason: The full season guard-archetype index is reviewed; names do not establish faction membership. Explicit single-affiliation profile fields now produce undated faction edges; ambiguous multi-affiliation pages and exact guard/faction/location season joins remain withheld.
Boss keycard drops and prior named vault records are retained. A keycard does not prove which door it opens without explicit evidence.
